specs/104-touch-key-id-criteria.title: Feature Specification: Touch key identity criteria — when a touch key is K_, U_, or T_
specs/104-touch-key-id-criteria.notes: Implemented 2026-10-17/18 in four waves (PRs #2266, #2267, #2272 + the Wave 4 close-out branch): one production resolver in contracts (FR-003) consumed by coverage, diagnostics, carve, enumeration, placement replay, combo propagation, the scaffolder and the proposer; decideKeyIdForm() implements the contracts §2 decision table (FR-005); severTouchKey()/relinkTouchKey() rule-level transplants with refusal records (FR-008/FR-029); marks-step guard station + GuardSpecification decision (FR-013); Copy parity gate + repair list with the FR-015 unvisited-at-Output ruling; Track 2 inline identity choices with FR-017 fingerprint-pinned decline suppression; key-inspector criterion/production/provenance section (FR-025); four Playwright walks (T023). T026 refusal probe over the corpus: 745 K_-linked touch keys, 12.4% candidate refusal rate (17.7% raw over all requests incl. arm-0-holds cases; utilities/refusal-probe/refusal-report.md). Full FR-by-FR trace and the deviation/adjudication record: specs/104-touch-key-id-criteria/AS-BUILT.md. T021 (corpus gate) and T022 (caps-fallback probe — settled: the caps-state K_ fallback fires) landed with the Wave 4 gates crew and are recorded in the AS-BUILT's Wave 4 gates section. Per the ack-routing convention this entry is adjudicated from main; the hash acknowledges spec.md as merged. Re-acknowledged 2026-10-20 for the Clarifications Session 2026-10-20 entry (empty-context guard ruling: 'start of a word' = the idiom's reachable cases; walk 1's start-of-word probe is the after-a-space tap). Re-acknowledged 2026-10-30 for the #2374 re-ruling (km-lead ruling, spec amendments on km/queue-2374): the per-keyboard guard question is retired; buffer start is offered per mark via the start-of-line column (spec 106 FR-015) — unticked = `nul` swallow rule + guarded `T_` mint, ticked = no `nul` rule + `"\n"` in the mark's allowed set + plain `U_` mint; only confirmed GuardSpecification records migrate (`origin: "migrated-from-guard"`); Track 2 keyboard-wide guard seeding retired in favour of per-mark box seeding (`origin: "imported"`).
